name: Dumbbell Split Squat
steps: Stand in a split stance with your rear heel lifted and a dumbbell in each hand.
Keep your torso upright, brace your core, and bend both knees to lower your back knee straight down toward the floor.
Descend until your front thigh is roughly parallel to the floor and your back knee hovers just above the ground.
Press through your front foot to rise, then switch legs.
tips: Keep your front knee tracking in line with your toes rather than collapsing inward.
Maintain hip-width spacing side to side between your feet for better balance.
